pre_invocation_conditions: A routed proposal explicitly includes this candidate and allowed_network_hosts contains exactly api.crossref.org; a route proposal alone is not execution permission.
Even a COMPLETE planner result has execution_authorized=false and does not verify the caller's authority behind the host declaration.
Every actual CLI invocation separately requires --allow-public-network and caller approval to transmit its selected DOI identifiers.
Remain excluded unless the caller explicitly allowlists research.compare_crossref_reference_metadata and the typed route profile explicitly lists api.crossref.org.

The caller has explicitly selected up to five DOI-bearing reference rows and approves their DOI transmission; when verify_source_link is true, the caller also approves sending the source-work DOI to the public Crossref API.

The exact input follows the JSON Schema at ignition/schemas/operations/toolbox-crossref-reference-metadata-comparison-input-r1.schema.json; verify_source_link is an optional boolean defaulting to false.
selected_tools.claim_ceiling: For up to five caller-selected Crossref reference rows, report normalized supplied-field equality or difference against the DOI-resolved target Work. With verify_source_link=true, additionally report whether the fetched source Work returned the requested DOI and whether each selected key is unique and bound to the same DOI in Crossref-deposited references before target lookup. Differences do not prove incorrect citations; matches do not establish source authenticity, reference provenance, bibliography completeness, article content, or scientific support.
